summary: CCC-built 1938 steel Aermotor tower on Colville Reservation land in Ferry County; gated, and non-tribal visitors need a permit.

facts.design: Steel Aermotor tower with a steel shelter on top

access.note: On Colville Reservation land and gated. Non-tribal visitors need a Colville Confederated Tribes recreation permit (trail guide: $80 a year).

visit.trail_note: Long drive on reservation back roads, then a gate that prevents access. The 2019 trail guide describes views from the base of the tower.

facts.agency: US Forest Service - Colville National Forest

events.note: Newspaper report of a planned 110-foot steel tower at George mountain that fall
Built by the Civilian Conservation Corps; the only tower on the site. Register and two guides give 100 ft; a 1960 inspection gives 110 ft.
Teachers staffed summer lookouts, including Mr. and Mrs. Walter Peterson of Malott on Johnny George
Inspection: living quarters a 20 x 15 ft Quonset hut in fair to poor condition; tower and shelter generally in good condition; dwelling cabin outlived its usefulness
Williams Flats fire (45,000 acres, started in August by lightning) threatened the lookout; the lookout was protected

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A 1937 newspaper announced a planned 110-foot tower for that fall; the register, both guides and the fire lookout page date the finished tower to 1938.

notes_for_editor: Height is unresolved (100 ft in the register and two guides; 110 ft in the 1937 plan and 1960 inspection), so no height_m is given. Agency conflict: the register says USFS Colville National Forest, while the trail guide and fire lookout page place the land on the Colville Indian Reservation. Access record said unknown; set to permission. The permit fee comes from a guide last updated March 2024 and should be confirmed with the Colville Confederated Tribes. Cache check: the washingtonlookouts.weebly.com URL returned a multi-lookout Forest Lookouts page with the Johnny George entry, and the firelookout.com URL returned a short page; confirm URL-to-title pairs before publishing. Record coordinates, elevation (1,247 m) and built year 1938 match the register. Photo credited to Rex Kamstra on the firelookout.com page has no licence given, so not added. Fact-check 2026-10-08: removed the climbing advice because the trail guide does not mention climbing, so visit.climbable was dropped; the visitor line now paraphrases the trail guide.
